selection: Retain every model and seed; primary equal average of 3 saved predictions; annual Top20 primary and Top25 secondary unchanged
metrics: AUC/AP/Brier replay; Brier exact algebraic mean-bias and centered-residual decomposition (not a calibrated forecast); outcome-ground mean risk/annual fixed-budget capture/case-versus-original-nontermination-control AUC; no reassignment of other termination causes to controls
policy_rule: Actual final-X announcement date and explicit terminal T/X text; date overlap is descriptive, not causal; unknown and mixed-version texts remain explicit; no reverse filling future rule knowledge into entry inputs
information: Verify 75 fitted columns and audited original market values, entry-type/audit/annual-publication evidence; same-day disclosure not automatically available under frozen original origin; no financial vintage repair claimed
support: Traverse existing q2 trees and record price eligibility/use and target support at reached test leaves, reconstruct frozen forecasts; no subtree selection
uncertainty: Small outcome-defined groups are descriptive; no causal DID/control, no tuning, no new bootstrap or p-value search
privacy: Only aggregate CSV, source hashes, code and report in Git; identifiers, dates per company, forecasts, source text, leaf paths, cutpoints and parameters remain private
resource_layout: Small fixed-forecast calculations directly on oliver; no fits or Slurm duplication
